title: It is a grayish green color not black
text: It is a grayish green color not black. Well first of all it’s a grey-green color not black. If you wanted it to actually be black you’re going to be disappointed. I still like it enough to keep it because you can put things on it while you’re cooking. I have the tiniest kitchen ever so the storage is nice. It would be even nicer in black.

description: Use this attractive tempered glass stove burner cover to add extra counter space to any kitchen. The board measures 20 3/8"L x 12"W and comes with 4 non-removable silicone rubber feet that are each 1" long. Place over 2 burners (of most standard sized stove tops) on a stove and use as cutting board, for hot pots and pans and for added counter space. By Trademark Innovations.
